baseline_kernel: SGLang grouped_gemm_nt_f8f8bf16_masked -> DeepGEMM fp8_m_grouped_gemm_nt_masked, stock alignment 128

bottleneck.evidence: Across the four pinned production-ABI workloads, NCU measured stock kernel duration 75.520--76.256 us and alignment-16 duration 68.576--70.112 us; the alignment-16 kernel retained only 4.18--4.23% tensor-pipe active time, 0.059--0.060 eligible warps per scheduler, and a 21.47--21.62 long-scoreboard ratio, while SourceCounters placed the dominant samples in barrier and TMA-wait paths.

approaches.summary: Swept alignments 128, 32, 64, 96, and 16 over the two plan buckets and the two current-source expected-M variants using three sessions of 30 alternating pairs per row.
approaches.why: Alignment 16 was correct and had exact paired medians of 1.0804698551877183, 1.087435633273191, 1.0755644970165608, and 1.0620687136354947, but its selector is process-global and therefore cannot provide fail-closed per-bucket production dispatch.

approaches.summary: Evaluated a BM32 dynamic tail, SM reservation, cluster-N=1, static-M compilation, and a new CLC/persistent scheduler against the measured config and profiler evidence.
approaches.why: The stock library already exposes the best measured BM16 leaf, all four expected-M hints select the same code shape, and none of the proposed rewrites resolves the process-global dispatch or unavailable eight-rank acceptance boundary.

approaches.summary: Specified a fail-closed oracle over SM100, 148 SMs, E32/slab1024, N6144/K2048, packed int32 UE8M0 scales, no recipe or overlap, and the exact M/expected-M pairs 16/4, 16/5, 32/8, and 32/9.
approaches.why: No safe per-call DeepGEMM selector exists in the pinned API, and the four-GPU host cannot validate live EP8 masks, overlap contracts, or the unchanged TP8 full-region and end-to-end gates.

lesson: A smaller M tile can remove padded epilogue and store work in low-row grouped GEMM decode while leaving MMA and input-TMA counts unchanged, but a leaf speedup is not deployable when configuration is process-global. Require a fail-closed per-call selector plus the real distributed topology, overlap, graph, full-region, and end-to-end gates; otherwise keep stock active.
transfers_to: packed-UE8M0 masked FP8 grouped GEMM decode on sm_100
persistent MoE down-projection kernels with low per-expert row counts and padded M epilogues
caveats: The measured masks are deterministic E32 production-ABI test data, not live TP8/DP8/EP8 router observations.
CUDA Graph and edge-mask validation covers only the single-GPU leaf; a four-rank diagnostic cannot satisfy the unchanged eight-rank acceptance gates.
Alignment 16 can increase logical tile count and B reloads for experts with more than 16 rows, so the fixed-bucket result must not be generalized to arbitrary masks.
This serving-native production-ABI campaign is not a frozen task run.sh result, so result speedup, conservative speedup, and repeat fields are intentionally null.
